# Dual-runtime pins (CI matrix: 3.9 + 3.14). Each python_version branch
# mirrors a locally verified venv exactly; pip selects the right branch.
#
# Security note: the starlette fixes (PYSEC-2026-248/2281/2280 -> >=1.1.0)
# and the pytest fix (PYSEC-2026-1845 -> >=9.0.3) all require Python >=3.10.
# The 3.9 branch therefore stays on the last 3.9-supporting (vulnerable)
# versions as recorded accepted risk until 3.9 retires from the CI matrix
# (security tracker item #9). The 3.14/production branch is clean.
#
# Hash-locked: every pin AND its transitive closure carry --hash=sha256
# digests for both marker branches (pip auto-enables --require-hashes as
# soon as any line carries a hash, so the closure must be complete —
# including linux-only deps an Apple-Silicon Mac never resolves, e.g.
# greenlet for the 3.9 branch). After changing any pin, regenerate with:
#     scripts/pin_requirements.py
